## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

*Pivot of Daoist Doctrinal Meanings*

by [孟安排](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E5%AD%9F%E5%AE%89%E6%8E%92) (Mèng Ānpái) — late 7th-century Táng Daoist scholar

**One of the major Táng systematic doctrinal encyclopedias of Daoism** — providing authoritative definitions for the categories and concepts of Daoist teaching. Mèng's work reorganizes material from the earlier *Xuán mén dà yì* ([KR5e0026](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR5/KR5e/KR5e0026)) into a systematic 10-*juàn* reference. An indispensable tool for understanding Táng Daoist theological vocabulary. Preserved as **DZ 1129** / CT 1129 (Tài píng bù 太平部).

**Dating.** Late 7th / early 8th century. Dynasty: 唐.
